title: ModelInfo
description: Output of `dmtool model info` — a single model's header dashboard: identity, the super/subtype convention (parsed from the `abstract`/`superTypes`/`subTypes` header annotations), every outbound model reference (an `include` or a type-def import) cross-resolved to its file via -w/--workspace (default the model's folder; `resolvedPath` is null when unresolved), the remaining (non-convention) model annotations, and COMPACT COUNTS only. The contents those counts summarize live in their own verbs — fields/groups in `model describe`, rules/computations in `model read`, the full config in `config read`, declared type-defs in `typedef read`.

fileName.description: the model FILE's name, verbatim (e.g. Order_DM.json) — emitted so the A12 Tools packaging invariant is checkable from a read rather than inferred from the -m argument: the basename must equal `id`. Absent when the model came from a source with no file name. No verb warns about a disagreement — the kernel does not enforce the convention and a warning would fire on every copy-to-a-scratch-name working file (CLI-SPEC). Compare them yourself, tolerating a double extension: an id equal to either the last-extension stem or the all-extensions stem agrees, so `cover.dm.json` matches id `cover`.

fileNameMatchesId.description: whether `fileName`'s basename agrees with `id`, which is the A12 Tools packaging invariant. Present exactly when `fileName` is. The comparison TOLERATES a double extension — the id may equal the name without its last extension (Order_DM.json → Order_DM) or without all of them (cover.dm.json → cover) — because A12 Tools' handling of `.dm.json` is not measured by this project and the strict reading would condemn that whole convention. false therefore means the names disagree under EVERY stripping rule. Reported as a fact on this opt-in read and never as a diagnostic: the kernel does not enforce the convention, and a warning would fire on every copy-to-a-scratch-name working file (CLI-SPEC).

label.description: the model's display label (first declared locale); absent if none

locales.description: declared locale codes (the message locales a rule/computation must each cover)

abstract.description: the `abstract` header-annotation convention — a base type, not instantiated directly

superTypes.description: model ids declared as supertypes (`superTypes` annotation, comma-split)

subTypes.description: model ids declared as subtypes (`subTypes` annotation, comma-split)

annotations.description: the model-level header annotations EXCEPT the super/subtype convention keys (those are parsed into abstract/superTypes/subTypes above)

includes.description: header includes (mounted sub-models), cross-resolved to files

typedefImports.description: type-def imports (merged by id, not mounted), cross-resolved to files

counts.description: compact element counts (not contents — see the per-facet read verbs)

ref.description: the included model's id, which every mount of it names in `includeConfig.reference` — the include's only identity (DM 29.4)

resolvedPath.description: the referenced model's path within the include dir, or null if unresolved

ref.description: the imported type-def provider model id

resolvedPath.description: the provider model's path within the include dir, or null if unresolved
